text.description_html:
15 Inch Art Deco Shower Door Pulls

For over 10 years, First Impressions has been designing and manufacturing the most amazing custom shower door pulls for homes, right here is the U.S.A. Dress up your glass shower doors with these 15" art deco design pulls made of solid brass and hand finished in your choice of 4 different high quality finishes.

Specifications of First Impressions First Impressions SD-DECORB1/15 Deco Shower Door Pulls

  • Total Length: 15"
  • Mounting Center to Center: 6" C/C (distance between the 2 mounting holes)
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Material: Brass

Note: These deco design shower door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pulls and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
